The Android Gradle wrapper launch script, JAR and properties were initially copied from the existing pulse-gov Android checkout. They use Gradle 8.14.3. Upstream: https://github.com/gradle/gradle/tree/v8.14.3/gradle/wrapper and https://gradle.org/. The distribution SHA-256 is pinned from https://services.gradle.org/distributions/gradle-8.14.3-all.zip.sha256. The accompanying licence and notice apply to Gradle tooling; they do not choose a licence for SDK source.
